notes.title: Patch v1.0.7
notes.notes:
A couple of small fixes, but with a broad impact.

- Now the position of NODE when reaching a Checkpoint is corrected on reset and loading to ensure no corrupt or broken state is permanent within a saved game. This will also fix the saved games of those affected by the issue. (If you see now a big difference between the execution on your first try vs the second, that means your original state wasn't correct, so "it is not a bug, it's a feature ;)"

- Fixed some serialization issues when the OS was set to different regions that prevented the dialogues from being triggered correctly. This will also work on past saved games.

Thank you all for your continuous feedback and support
Lapsus Games

notes.title: NODE is now Steam Deck Verified!
notes.notes: [p]Survivors, we bring good news from Toska![/p][p][/p][p]NODE: The Last Favor of the Antarii is now officially [b]Steam Deck Verified[/b]. That means you can take your mission into the collapsing reactor anywhere — with controls, display, and performance fully optimized for handheld play.[/p][p][/p][p]When we first launched on Steam Deck, we announced that the game was playable. Thanks to updates, testing, and your feedback, we’ve pushed it further — and now NODE runs flawlessly.[/p][p][/p][p]This is one more step toward ensuring you can experience Toska’s story wherever you are.[/p]

notes.title: Patch v1.0.6
notes.notes: [p]Thanks again to everyone for reporting issues and sending feedback. That way, we're able to fix it for everyone. These are the things that this patch fixes.[/p][p][/p][list][*][p]Possible Soft Lock while reaching the Checkpoint to repair the electric panel at the beginning of the game should be fixed now. That checkpoint will be harder to trigger by accident (don't try though XD)[/p][/*][*][p]Possible Soft Lock after speaking to PRIZMA for the first time has been eliminated.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed sometimes you could slide NODE down a vertical wall without dying.[/p][/*][*][p]The Second Phase of the Crane won't allow you to go down a level and save the state of the cart in a different position. [/p][/*][*][p]The Steam Deck now features a slightly larger font size, Timeline, and UI scale to enhance readability.[/p][/*][*][p]Steam Deck now won't show Keyboard or Mouse controls when touching the screen. notes.title: Patch v1.0.4
notes.notes: [p]Thanks to your feedback, we addressed some of the bugs you have encountered and we also improved some accessibility issues with the default controls. Here is the list of changes:[/p][p][/p][list][*][p]When using Mouse and Keyboard, there are now two more options to change the decimal numbers on the commands. While hovering over the command to change, besides the scroll wheel, you can now use the Up and Down arrow keys, as well as the Middle and Right buttons for it. [/p][/*][*][p]A small sound effect that was causing issues during streamings on Twitch and YouTube has been substituted for one made in-house. [p]After watching hundreds of you step into the ruins, solve puzzles, break our demo (thanks), and piece together NODE’s systems, we went back into the facility one last time.

notes.title: Playtesting Demo Now Live — Request Your Key
notes.notes:
Hello Drones,

The NODE playtest demo is now live, and you might be one of the few to receive access. This isn’t a public test (yet), but we’re quietly rolling out Steam keys to players interested in stepping into Toska before anyone else.

This early version of NODE is still in development. You may encounter glitches, incomplete polish, and interfaces that need refinement, and that’s exactly why we need you. Your feedback will help us shape the game into its final form.

[h3][b]🧪 What’s in the Playtest Demo?[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] A sneak peek into NODE’s opening chapter.
[*] Timeline-based puzzle mechanics that let you plan and adjust NODE’s actions.
[*] Early narrative choices.
[*] Around 20-30 minutes of gameplay.
[*] Steam Deck support & full controller compatibility.
[/list]

[h3][b]📡 FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS[/b][/h3]
[b]How do I get access to the playtest?[/b]
We’re distributing keys manually for now. Check your inbox, DMs, or join our [url=https://discord.gg/GA4A2gkFvG]Discord server[/url] to request one.

[b]Is this a public demo?[/b]
Not yet. This is a closed playtest with limited access. We’ll announce more plans soon.

[b]Where can I send my feedback?[/b]
We’ve prepared a short form here:
👉 [url=https://forms.gle/X8FsfGYzfPgr7sXr9]https://forms.gle/X8FsfGYzfPgr7sXr9[/url]
You can also reach out on Discord if that’s easier.

[b]Can I stream or post about the game?[/b]
Yes! Just note it’s a playtest version and still in development. If you post, tag us because we’d love to see it.

[b]What languages are supported right now?[/b]
The demo is available in English, Spanish, Portuguese, French, Italian, Deutsch, Japanese, Korean, Simplified Chinese, Russian, and Ukrainian.

[b]Will this be the same as the final game?[/b]
The core experience will stay the same, but we’ll be making improvements based on your feedback.

Thank you for being here with us at the beginning!

notes.title: ⚙️ NODE Demo Update – Sharper, Smoother, Smarter
notes.notes:
It’s been a few months since NODE’s first demo release. Since then, we’ve been quietly working, tweaking, testing, and tuning. Now that NODE is entering its polishing phase, it’s time to update the demo to better reflect where the game currently stands.

The demo is temporarily unavailable on Steam while we roll out this updated version. We know some of you were hoping to try it or revisit it sooner, and we appreciate your patience. It’ll be back, better than ever.

[h2]🧠 Save Progress That Carries Over[/h2]

The biggest change? You can now carry your save file from the demo into the full game. Whether you like playing in long sessions or short bursts, NODE will meet you where you are. Start now, pick up later, your progress stays with you.

[h2]🖼️ Visual Upgrades You Can Feel[/h2]

Every level in NODE was crafted with the story in mind. This update brings the earlier sections up to the visual fidelity of the rest. Atmosphere, lighting, and detail now better match the game’s tone. And yes, we’ve been squashing FPS drops along the way.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/yDnukil.png[/img]

[h2]⏱️ Gameplay That Feels Just Right[/h2]

Things play smoother now. We’ve added quality-of-life updates:

[list]
[*] Adjust game speed to skip downtime
[*] Pause the timeline to read moments with precision
[*] See exact second values instead of vague bars
[/list]
More control = more satisfying problem-solving.

[h2]📘 Smarter Onboarding[/h2]

New to NODE? The updated intro includes helpful guidance for first-time players. It’s subtle, but effective. No hand-holding. Just what you need, when you need it.

[h2]🖥️ Polished UI, No Matter How You Play[/h2]

We’ve overhauled the interface for clarity and comfort, whether you’re on a keyboard or gamepad. Smoother button feedback. Cleaner sound design. Small details, big difference.

NODE’s world has always been about precision and curiosity, and we’ve tried to carry that mindset into every update. Thanks to everyone who played the first version of the demo. Your feedback shaped this.

We’re making more improvements behind the scenes, stay tuned for the updated demo, coming soon.
[center]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/nOQC7j1.gif[/img]
[/center]

notes.title: NODE Demo - Patch Notes v0.6.6.7
notes.notes:
Thanks to all the players for your feedback and bug reporting. We hope these changes make your journey "easier" :)

[b]New Features added:[/b]
- Now the Timeline has a Marker that remains at the point of the sequence when you die or you press Reset. This will give you a permanent place of reference to adjust your sequence until you execute it again.
- While the Timeline executes you can hold "F" or the Left button on your Controller to accelerate time and skip forward the parts of the solution you don't need to adjust.

[b]Bug fixed:[/b]
- The map no longer drifts when additional controllers and joysticks are connected.
- The Idle pose of the character returns to its normal state after resetting while colliding with something.
- Fixed some rare cases where the execution of the same commands yields a different result.
- The Commands duration can no longer be altered using the keyboard while the Timeline executes.
- Fixed an issue that was contributing to frame drops while loading levels.
